description: [PUBLISH] Re-generate the authorization code for a GTM environment. Requires GTM_MCP_ENABLE_PUBLISH=true and confirm=true. ⚠️  This rotates the environment auth token; any embedded snippet using the old token stops working until updated.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm this high-impact operation.

environmentId.description: The GTM environment ID to reauthorize.

name: environments_reauthorize
